notes.title: 0.2 Hotfix 3 & 4
notes.notes:
Update version 0.2 Hotfix 3 & 4
Patch 0.2 hotfix 3 & 4 has now been deployed, please consider restarting Steam if you don’t see the update.

🥫 Fixes and improvements🥫

 Fixed combat logging (it would log you out immediately, not it waits the full timer),
 Fixed several issues with the loot spawns,
 Fixed loot not despawning on the ground,
 Balanced zombie drops (they will drop far less loot now),
 Refactored the inventory system (if you notice any bug, please report the issue)
 Fixed a server crash
 Fixed several issues with the furnaces


⚠️Known issues⚠️

 Holstered weapons will lose their magazine when you log out and back in

notes.title: update version 0.2.2 hotfix 1
notes.notes:
Patch 0.2.2 hotfix 1 has now been deployed. Restart Steam if you don’t see the update.

❄️New features❄️

 Added cooking with a pan (improving cooking speed)
 Added sound effects to cooking
 Added Trigger + Grip to remove full stacks of items (Grip now removes one of an item from storage)


🥫 Fixes and improvements🥫

 Fixed zombie headshot audio playing for all players nearby
 Fixed dead players and sleepers items being set to 1
 Fixed storage containers (Orange Crates) items being set to 1
 Fixed a bug allowing certain consumables to stack
 Fixed a bug allowing players to consume an entire stack of items
 Fixed a bug causing stacked items to be used while only giving 1 items stats
 Fixed a bug causing canned food to spawn opened
 Fixed deer spawns (won’t spawn as many)
 Fixed zombies not dropping loot
 Fixed the ability to drink when not thirsty
 Fixed the ability to eat when not hungry
 Improved furnace  reliability
 Improved player's chest reliability
 Improved cooking performance over network
 Improved loot spawning logic (loot should spawn back more often now)

notes.title: Patch 0.2 - Cooking and more! 🍳
notes.notes:
Patch 0.2 has now been deployed, please consider restarting your Quest headset after patch is applied. On Steam, restart the application if you don’t see the update.

❄️ New features ❄️

 Added Cooking v1 (more tweaks and tuning coming later!)
 Added zombie drops (zombies have a small chance of dropping a low grade item)
 Added item information UI (if you hold an item and look at it, holding the top button/B/Y of your controller will display an information panel)


🥫 Fixes and improvements 🥫

 Fixed code locks not working
 Fixed players chest reliability
 Fixed furnace reliability
 Fixed hip holster not saving item when logging back
 Fixed attachments disappearing on holstered items when logging back
 Fixed lids not culling on some objects when the object would cull
 Fixed vials spawning almost empty every time
 Fixed a server crash
 Improved networking

notes.title: Hotfix 3 and Hotfix 4
notes.notes:
Silent North
update version 0.1 Hotfix 3
Patch 0.1 hotfix 3 has now been deployed, if you don’t see the update, restart Steam.

❄️New features❄️

 Added a confirmation button to “respawn”
 Added a death screen for players killed while logged out
 Added a combat log warning (3minutes) on the menu to educate players on combat logging


🥫 Fixes and improvements🥫

 Fixed hunger and thirst not depleting
 Fixed holstering not working if the off-hand was interacting/hovering another slot
 Fixed ice not making footstep sounds
 Fixed magazines slot showing for melee weapons
 Fixed stoves not accepting stick bundles
 Fixed quickslot destroying invalid items
 Fixed headshots not properly registering on server
 Fixed a server crash
 Fixed stove light not showing properly
 Fixed holstering tearing visually
 Fixed zombies hitting players after being stabbed in the head
 Fixed zombies hitting players while being stabbed
 Fixed fridge door not being aligned
 Fixed holsters being high on the body
 Fixed holstered weapons not dropping on death
 Fixed holster and wrist UI tearing in world
 Fixed pistols not gripping properly
 Fixed large weapons not gripping properly


update version 0.1 Hotfix 4
Patch 0.1 hotfix 4 has now been deployed,  if you don’t see the update, restart Steam.

❄️New features❄️

 Added the inability to eat when hunger is full (preventing healing exploit through food)


🥫 Fixes and improvements🥫

 Fixed progression not saving
 Fixed the accidental fall damage from sliding down a slope (if it’s a big slope, you will still receive damage)
 Fixed hitching when switching hands on pistol
 Fixed in-game map not matching the current map (mainly snow)
 Fixed a server crash
 Fixed a crash associated with the wrist UI
 Fixed weapons loosing attachments in the backpack

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Silent North

Patch 0.1.1 hotfix 1 has now been deployed, please consider restarting your Quest headset after patch is applied. On Steam, restart the application if you don’t see the update.

 ❄️New features ❄️  

 Added sounds when equipping outfit


🥫 Fixes and improvements 🥫

 Fixed secondary holster starter weapon disappearing
 Fixed medical injector not loading
 Fixed some items missing sound when putting in backpack
 Fixed voice chat being too low
 Fixed zombie attacking “in the air” when spotting a player

 ⚠️ Known issues ⚠️

 Legs will go in the floor when crouching
 Looting a dead player’s backpack will visually duplicate items (not updating) until you let go and grab the backpack again
